hints.title: Adjacent Plot Emptiness Condition
hints.text: A flower can be planted at an empty plot if and only if both the immediate left and right plots are also empty or out of bounds.

hints.title: Eager Planting Invariant
hints.text: Planting a flower at the earliest possible valid plot never reduces the options for subsequent planting opportunities.

hints.title: Sequential Greedy Planting Procedure
hints.text: Traverse the flowerbed from left to right. When encountering a zero, check whether the left neighbor is zero or index is zero, and right neighbor is zero or index is at the end. If both are satisfied, mark the plot as one and increment the planted count. Return whether the count reaches n.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively exploring branching placement combinations causes exponential call overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single greedy pass mutates or inspects plots in O(N) time and requires O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle boundary edges (index 0 and length - 1) cleanly and consider early termination when count reaches n.
